findings.text: The company was incorporated on 21 June 1894 and has been active for 132.3 years.
There are 11 current officers, comprising 10 directors and 1 other officer.
Accounts are not overdue, with the next due date being 30 June 2027, and the last accounts were made up to 31 December 2025.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the next due date being 23 June 2027, and the last statement was made up to 9 June 2026.
No person with significant control is currently on record, although this does not prove the company has no owner.
No charges are registered against the company.
No insolvency record is held for the company.

Since 24 October 2025, there has been one officer appointment and one resignation, involving the appointment of PERSON 470 as secretary on 1 March 2026 and the resignation of PERSON 485 as secretary on 28 February 2026.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 478 is an active company incorporated in 1894 with no insolvency records, no overdue filings, and no registered charges.
